```{r}
# =============================================================================

poulter <- list(
  "10"  = list(Crop = 0.90, Grass = 0.10),

  "40"  = list(Tree = 0.15, Shrub = 0.35, Grass = 0.30, Crop = 0.20),
  "50"  = list(Tree = 0.90, Shrub = 0.10),
  "60"  = list(Tree = 0.50, Shrub = 0.20, Grass = 0.30),
  "61"  = list(Tree = 0.70, Shrub = 0.15, Grass = 0.15),
  "62"  = list(Tree = 0.30, Shrub = 0.25, Grass = 0.45),
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 2. Preparar lookups y clases válidas (SOLO para Tree)
# =============================================================================
valid_classes <- as.integer(names(poulter))

pft_names <- c("Tree")  # <--- SOLO Tree

# Inicializar lookups SOLO para Tree
lookups <- setNames(lapply(pft_names, function(p) rep(0, 256)), pft_names)

get_frac <- function(lst, key) if (key %in% names(lst)) lst[[key]] else 0

for (lc_class in names(poulter)) {
  idx <- as.integer(lc_class) + 1
  frac_list <- poulter[[lc_class]]
  for (pft in pft_names) {
    lookups[[pft]][idx] <- get_frac(frac_list, pft)
  }
}

# Verificar que Tree tenga valores > 0 en las clases correctas
cat("Clases con Tree > 0:\n")
tree_classes <- which(lookups[["Tree"]] > 0) - 1  # -1 porque R es 1-indexed
print(tree_classes)

```


```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 3. Función de reclasificación (SOLO Tree)
# =============================================================================
reclassify_pft <- function(raster_obj, lookup, valid_classes) {
  from_to <- cbind(valid_classes, lookup[valid_classes + 1])
  classify(raster_obj, rcl = from_to, others = NA)
}
```



# =============================================================================
# 4. Función para reducir resolución
# =============================================================================
```{r}
# Definir función modal si no existe
if (!exists("modal")) {
  modal <- function(x) {
    ux <- unique(x)
    ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))]
  }
}


# =============================================================================
# 4. Función para reducir resolución
# =============================================================================
agregar_raster <- function(raster_obj, factor, fun = "modal") {
  aggregate(raster_obj, fact = factor, fun = modal, na.rm = TRUE)
}

```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 6. PROCESAR AÑOS (SOLO Tree) - PARA TODAS LAS REGIONES
# =============================================================================

# Lista para almacenar resultados por región
results <- list()

for (region in names(esa_files_combined)) {
  cat("\n", paste(rep("=", 60), collapse = ""), "\n")
  cat("📍 PROCESANDO REGIÓN:", region, "\n")
  cat(paste(rep("=", 60), collapse = ""), "\n")
  
  files <- esa_files_combined[[region]]
  n_years <- length(files)
  
  cat("📊 Procesando", n_years, "años para", region, "...\n")
  
  # Inicializar acumulador SOLO para Tree
  sum_tree <- NULL
  
  for (i in seq_along(files)) {
    year <- as.numeric(str_extract(basename(files[i]), "\\d{4}"))
    cat("\n  📅 Procesando año", year, "...\n")
    
    # Leer raster
    r <- rast(files[i], subds = "lccs_class")
    
    cat("     Resolución original:", res(r)[1], "° x", res(r)[2], "°\n")
    cat("     Dimensiones originales:", nrow(r), "x", ncol(r), "\n")
    
    # Reducir resolución si está activado
    if (REDUCIR_RESOLUCION) {
      cat("     🔽 Reduciendo resolución (factor =", FACTOR_AGREGACION, ")...\n")
      r <- agregar_raster(r, FACTOR_AGREGACION, fun = "modal")
      cat("     Resolución agregada:", res(r)[1], "° x", res(r)[2], "°\n")
      cat("     Dimensiones agregadas:", nrow(r), "x", ncol(r), "\n")
    } else {
      cat("     ✅ Usando resolución original\n")
    }
    
    # Reclasificar a Tree PFT
    cat("     Extrayendo fracción de Tree...\n")
    tree_i <- reclassify_pft(r, lookups[["Tree"]], valid_classes)
    
    # Acumular
    if (is.null(sum_tree)) {
      sum_tree <- tree_i
    } else {
      sum_tree <- sum_tree + tree_i
    }
    
    rm(r, tree_i)
    gc()
  }
  
  # Guardar el acumulador para esta región
  results[[region]] <- list(
    sum_tree = sum_tree,
    n_years = n_years
  )
}

```




```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 8. Calcular promedio de Tree para cada región
# =============================================================================

for (region in names(results)) {
  cat("\n", paste(rep("=", 60), collapse = ""), "\n")
  cat("📊 Calculando promedio de Tree para:", region, "\n")
  cat(paste(rep("=", 60), collapse = ""), "\n")
  
  sum_tree <- results[[region]]$sum_tree
  n_years <- results[[region]]$n_years
  
  tree_mean <- sum_tree / n_years
  names(tree_mean) <- "Tree"
  
  # Guardar en la lista de resultados
  results[[region]]$tree_mean <- tree_mean
  
  # =============================================================================
  # 9. VERIFICACIÓN
  # =============================================================================
  cat(paste0("\n", paste(rep("=", 60), collapse = ""), "\n"))
  cat("✅ VERIFICACIÓN DE RESULTADOS -", region, "\n")
  cat(strrep("=", 60), "\n\n")
  
  # Estadísticas de Tree
  mean_val <- global(tree_mean, "mean", na.rm = TRUE)
  min_val <- global(tree_mean, "min", na.rm = TRUE)
  max_val <- global(tree_mean, "max", na.rm = TRUE)
  na_count <- global(tree_mean, fun = function(x) sum(is.na(x)))
  
  cat("🌳 Tree PFT (1992-2022 promedio) -", region, ":\n")
  cat("   Media:", round(mean_val[,1], 6), "\n")
  cat("   Mínimo:", round(min_val[,1], 6), "\n")
  cat("   Máximo:", round(max_val[,1], 6), "\n")
  cat("   NAs:", na_count[,1], "\n")
  
  # =============================================================================
  # 10. VISUALIZAR
  # =============================================================================
  plot(tree_mean, 
       main = paste("Tree frac. (1992-2022 / 300m resol) -", region),
       col = hcl.colors(100, "Greens", rev = TRUE))
}
```

Cómo se describe en palabras:
“Una secuencia geométrica con razón 2”
“Una progresión exponencial de base 2”
“Valores que se duplican en cada paso empezando en 0.75”
```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 1. DEFINIR TAMAÑOS DE BUFFER
# =============================================================================
buffer_sizes_km <- 0.75 * 2^(0:5)
names(buffer_sizes_km) <- paste0("buffer_", buffer_sizes_km)

cat("📏 Tamaños de buffer a utilizar:\n")
print(buffer_sizes_km)

# Convertir km a metros (st_buffer usa metros cuando el CRS es proyectado)
buffer_sizes_m <- buffer_sizes_km * 1000
```

# =============================================================================
# 2. FUNCIÓN PARA EXTRAER VALORES
# =============================================================================
```{r}

extract_tree_values_km <- function(raster_file, points_df, buffer_sizes_m) {
  
  # Cargar raster
  cat("\n📂 Cargando raster:", basename(raster_file), "\n")
  tree_raster <- rast(raster_file)
  
  # Crear objeto sf desde points_df en WGS84
  points_sf <- st_as_sf(points_df, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)
  
  # ===== EXTRACCIÓN EN PUNTO EXACTO =====
  cat("📍 Extrayendo valor en punto exacto...\n")
  point_values <- terra::extract(tree_raster, points_sf, ID = FALSE)
  colnames(point_values) <- "Tree_Point"
  
  # Mostrar estadísticas rápidas del punto
  cat("   ✅ Extracción puntual completada\n")
  cat("   📊 Estadísticas del punto exacto:\n")
  cat("      Media:", round(mean(point_values$Tree_Point, na.rm = TRUE), 4), "\n")
  cat("      Min:", round(min(point_values$Tree_Point, na.rm = TRUE), 4), "\n")
  cat("      Max:", round(max(point_values$Tree_Point, na.rm = TRUE), 4), "\n")
  cat("      NAs:", sum(is.na(point_values$Tree_Point)), "\n")
  
  # Inicializar lista de resultados con el punto
  results <- list(
    Tree_Point = point_values$Tree_Point
  )
  
  # ===== EXTRACCIÓN CON BUFFERS =====
  cat("\n🔄 Extrayendo valores con buffers circulares (en km)...\n")
  
  # Proyectar puntos a CRS en metros UNA SOLA VEZ (optimización)
  cat("   Preparando proyección de puntos...\n")
  points_proj <- st_transform(points_sf, crs = "+proj=eqc +lon_0=0 +lat_ts=0 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +ellps=WGS84 +units=m")
  
  for (i in seq_along(buffer_sizes_m)) {
    buf_size_m <- buffer_sizes_m[i]
    buf_size_km <- buf_size_m / 1000
    buf_name <- paste0("Tree_Buffer_", buf_size_km, "km")
    
    cat("   📍 Buffer:", buf_size_km, "km...")
    
    # Crear buffers circulares en metros
    buffers_sf <- st_buffer(points_proj, dist = buf_size_m)
    
    # Transformar de vuelta a WGS84 para extraer del raster
    buffers_sf <- st_transform(buffers_sf, crs = 4326)
    
    # Extraer valores (media de Tree fraction dentro del buffer)
    buffer_values <- terra::extract(tree_raster, buffers_sf, 
                                    fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE, ID = FALSE)
    colnames(buffer_values) <- buf_name
    
    # Guardar resultados
    results[[buf_name]] <- buffer_values[,1]
    
    # Mostrar estadísticas rápidas
    cat(" ✅ Completado\n")
    cat("      Media:", round(mean(buffer_values[,1], na.rm = TRUE), 4), "\n")
    cat("      NAs:", sum(is.na(buffer_values[,1])), "\n")
  }
  
  # Combinar todos los resultados en un data.frame
  result_df <- as.data.frame(results)
  
  # Agregar información de coordenadas y metadata
  result_df <- cbind(
    id_sample = points_df$id_sample,
    entity_name = points_df$entity_name,
    latitude = points_df$latitude,
    longitude = points_df$longitude,
    result_df
  )
  
  cat("\n✅ Extracción completada para todos los puntos y buffers\n")
  
  return(result_df)
}
```

Visualizacion
```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 3. RELACIÓN ENTRE TAMAÑO DE BUFFER Y MEDIA
# =============================================================================
# Seleccionar columnas de Tree
tree_cols <- grep("Tree", colnames(europe_extraction), value = TRUE)

# Preparar datos para visualización
europe_long <- europe_extraction %>%
  select(all_of(tree_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), 
               names_to = "Extraction_Type", 
               values_to = "Tree_Fraction")

# Extraer el tamaño del buffer de los nombres
europe_long <- europe_long %>%
  mutate(
    Buffer_Size = case_when(
      Extraction_Type == "Tree_Point" ~ "Punto",
      TRUE ~ gsub("Tree_Buffer_", "", Extraction_Type)
    ),
    Buffer_Size = factor(Buffer_Size, 
                         levels = c("Punto", "0.75km", "1.5km", "3km", "6km", "12km", "24km")))


# Calcular medias por buffer
buffer_means <- europe_long %>%
  filter(Buffer_Size != "Punto") %>%
  group_by(Buffer_Size) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(Tree_Fraction, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(Tree_Fraction, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Buffer_Size_Num = as.numeric(gsub("km", "", Buffer_Size))
  )

print(buffer_means)

# Gráfico de media vs buffer size
p3 <- ggplot(buffer_means, aes(x = Buffer_Size_Num, y = Mean)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "blue") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean - SD, ymax = Mean + SD), width = 0.5) +
  geom_line(group = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  labs(title = "Tree Fraction promedio vs tamaño de buffer",
       x = "Tamaño de buffer (km)", y = "Media de Tree Fraction") +
  theme_minimal()

print(p3)
```









```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 9. VISUALIZACIÓN
# =============================================================================

# Preparar datos para visualización
buffer_long <- resultados_tree_buffer %>%
  select(id_sample, latitude, longitude, starts_with("Tree_PFT")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Tree_PFT"),
    names_to = "buffer",
    values_to = "Tree_PFT"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    buffer_km = as.numeric(str_extract(buffer, "\\d+"))
  )

# Boxplot por buffer
ggplot(buffer_long, aes(x = factor(buffer_km), y = Tree_PFT)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "darkgreen", alpha = 0.6, color = "darkgreen") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 18, size = 4, color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Tree frac. by buffer size (1992-2015)",
    x = "Buffer size (km)",
    y = "Tree frac."
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Mapa con puntos coloreados por Tree PFT (buffer 6 km)
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = land_polyg, fill = "white") +
  geom_point(
    data = resultados_tree_buffer,
    aes(longitude, latitude, fill = Tree_PFT_6km),
    size = 1.8,
    shape = 21
  ) +
  jcolors::scale_fill_jcolors_contin(palette = "pal2") +
  labs(
    title = "Tree PFT (buffer 6 km, 1992-2015)",
    x = "Longitud", y = "Latitud",
    fill = "Tree fraction"
  ) +
  coord_sf() +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = land_polyg, fill = "white") +
  geom_point(
    data = resultados_tree_buffer,
    aes(longitude, latitude, fill = Tree_PFT_12km),
    size = 1.8,
    shape = 21
  ) +
  jcolors::scale_fill_jcolors_contin(palette = "pal2") +
  labs(
    title = "Tree PFT (buffer 12 km, 1992-2015)",
    x = "Longitud", y = "Latitud",
    fill = "Tree fraction"
  ) +
  coord_sf() +
  theme_minimal()
```
